release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.5

• **Light Mode Readability Fixed Across Windows & Android**: Fixed light theme text, contrast, chips, menus, sheets, and dialogs so track names, headers, and controls render crisply across all screens in Warm Ivory and White & Forest Green themes.
• **Widescreen Windows Minimalist Mode**: Responsive side-by-side studio layout tailored for desktop screens (>= 820px wide) while keeping compact mobile portrait layout intact.
• **Optional Windows Desktop Widgets (Resource-Optimized)**: Native Win32 layered overlay suite featuring Floating Synced Lyrics, Rotating Vinyl + 360° Live Radial Audio Visualizer, and Compact Orbital Now-Playing Hub under Settings → Desktop Widgets (Windows), with 15/30/60 FPS caps and 0% animation CPU when paused.
